messages:
Alex Chen: Hey team — building cost model for Dedicated + Marketplace. Need canonical inputs from hardware partners: supply windows, reserved term discounts (1/3/12/36 mo), spot availability & preemption rates, min commit sizes, lead times, and whether they list on marketplaces. Can partners provide CSV or table by EOD Wed? Example columns: partner,region,instance_type,reserved_monthly_usd,reserved_term_months,spot_avg_price_usd,spot_preempt_pct,lead_time_days,min_commit_gpus

Rachel M: putting this on partner's tracker. Will ping contacts at Lambda, CoreWeave, and our hyperscaler partners.

Samir Patel: For modeling, we also need volume tiers and any annual price step-downs. A per-GPU hourly equivalent helps. If possible include an SLO for "guaranteed capacity" vs "best-effort spot".

Maya Lopez: Marketplace note — most cloud marketplaces take ~15-30% cut; need to know if partner will list via marketplace or direct contract. That materially changes net revenue per-hour.

Chris O'Neill: From infra: prefer reserved terms of 3/12/36 months. Also note GPU supply is spotty in EMEA — region-specific availability important. Call out regions where partners reserve capacity vs only spot.

Rachel M: @Alex Chen I'll create a shared Google sheet and add vendor contacts. I'll add a "confidence" column for numbers that are estimates.

Alex Chen: thanks. Also flag any single-vendor lock-in language (ex: minimum committed units that block multivendor routing).

Samir Patel: sample CSV header I used for prior TF: 
```
partner,region,instance_type,reserved_monthly_usd,reserved_term_months,spot_avg_price_usd,spot_preempt_pct,lead_time_days,min_commit_gpus,marketplace_listing,revenue_share_pct,confidence
```

Maya Lopez: +1 on confidence. I'll follow up with legal on marketplace revenue share ranges for contracts.

partnerships-bot: Created doc: https://gdocs.example.com/hw-cost-inputs-2026 (permissions: partners@redwood.com)

Chris O'Neill: Also capture burst/buffer pricing — e.g., ability to burst 20% over commit at X price. Some partners only do burst on request; list whether burst is automated or manual.

Alex Chen: Owners: Rachel (vendor outreach), Samir (model integration), Chris (region availability). Deadline EOD Wed. Ping here if you need me to draft email template.

Rachel M: Drafting template now, will post in thread shortly :memo: 

Samir Patel: noted. Will mock sample numbers on Monday and share model cells so we can slot partner inputs.

Maya Lopez: FYI — SI partners asked if we want co-marketing when they commit capacity. We should decide later, but capture their ask in sheet.

Alex Chen: Cool. We'll table co-marketing for now. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
